hostname.description: Hostname used to identify this renderer on the network (via mDNS/D-Bus).

rest_api_port.description: Port to expose the internal REST API for diagnostics and control. Set to 0 to disable.

dbus_port.description: D-Bus daemon port to connect to. Set to 0 to use the system bus default.

max_transcoding_sessions.description: Maximum number of simultaneous audio/video transcoding sessions allowed.

enable_discovery.description: Whether to actively discover and register UPnP/AV devices on the network.

name.description: Human-readable name for the media profile.

encoder.description: Command to invoke for transcoding; supports %i (input), %o (output), %f (format).

mime_type.description: MIME type of the transcoded output (e.g., 'audio/mpeg', 'video/mp4').

enabled.description: Whether this profile is active for transcoding.

max_resolution.description: Maximum supported resolution (WxH) for video profiles. Leave empty for audio.

media_profiles.description: List of transcoding profiles to use when rendering media from incompatible sources.

dbus_service_file.description: Optional custom path to a D-Bus service file override. Empty = use default.

enable_glib.description: Enable GLib main loop integration for event handling and signal processing.
